back_translation: In that day, seven women will take hold of a single man and say, "We will eat our own food and wear our own clothing; only let us be called by your name. Please take away our disgrace!"
In that day, the Shoot of the LORD will be beautiful and full of glory, and the fruit of the land will be the pride and the splendor of the survivors of Israel.
And whoever is left in Zion, whoever still remains in Jerusalem, will be called holy — everyone who is recorded for life in Jerusalem,
when the Sovereign Master will have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion and rinsed the bloodstains of Jerusalem out of her midst, by a spirit of judgment and a spirit of burning away.

Then the LORD will create a cloud by day, with smoke and the brilliant glow of fire by night, over the whole area of Mount Zion and over her assemblies; for over all the glory there will be a ceremonial canopy spread.
And there will be a booth to give shade from the heat by day, and to be a refuge and a shelter from the storm and the rain.
